issue: Lost-prepare recovery accepted a PREPARED status after its scoped listing had reported SAVED, FAILED, or AUDIT_OR_COMMIT_PENDING, then bound the local attempt as PREPARED.
fix: Reject contradictory terminal state or started-to-PREPARED regression before local operation binding. Permit forward progress from PREPARED to a verified committed save.
method: Fictional local Node GAS-domain RPC. Negative cases alter only returned listing status, retain real request status, assert local PREPARING/unbound, no execute calls and unchanged offline store inspection. Positive case simulates an existing worker completing the same request between list and status; exactly one prepare, one execute and one audit. No live OIDC/ACL test.
